# Original library builds for detection verification

Pinned Leaflet 1.9.4, Chart.js 4.4.8 and Handlebars 4.7.8 distribution files were retrieved from the publishers' npm packages on November 9, 2026. `manifest.json` records each archive URL, member and SHA-256. License files are retained beside the assets.

These files are offline test inputs, not application dependencies or detector-rule corpora. Tests serve them from loopback. Their URLs are deliberately replaced with opaque paths so runtime and body recognition can be verified independently of filenames.
